name: Swim school

pf.license.need: from the state form: teaching swimming usually needs no state license; a pool used for lessons may need a health permit and inspections where the state's or county's rules require it (a switch); some places register a swim school or set rules for selling lessons ahead
pf.license.who: the business, for any registration and the school's pool permit; each instructor and lifeguard, for their own certificates
pf.license.ask: any business registration number; for the school's own pool, the pool permit number and its renewal date where the state's form asks; for each instructor, a current water safety instructor certificate and a CPR and first aid certificate; for each lifeguard, a current lifeguard certificate
pf.license.check: none: Rosie never looks up, checks or confirms a license, insurance or registration (D96); anything shown is as given by the business, not checked by Rosie
pf.license.certificates: lifesaving and CPR certificates for each instructor in the water, and a lifeguard certificate for anyone guarding: switches from the state's form, on by default; a person teaches or guards only while their certificates are current
pf.license.background: a background check for each person who teaches or works with children, where the state's rules require it (a switch from the state's form; the owner can also turn it on): who ran it and when, kept on file, renewed on the state's schedule
pf.license.blocks: nothing waits on a license (D96): the business and each person go live once set up and the owner says yes; a job the owner says needs a license they don't have isn't booked
pf.license.renewals: reminded 30 days before a certificate, a background check, the pool permit or insurance comes due; a lapsed certificate takes that person off lessons until it's renewed
pf.license.insurance: liability insurance where the state's form asks for it, or where a host pool (a community center, an apartment building) asks for proof

pf.services.shape: class: a spot in a set 30-minute group lesson by age and level, with a set number of swimmers per instructor, 1 trial spot per lesson and a waitlist; each swimmer is checked in on their own. A private lesson books one instructor, at the school's pool or the family's own pool. A lesson at a host pool (a community center, an apartment pool) books an instructor's time, with the host's OK
pf.services.examples: the example school's own prices (Lee Swim School and Lee Swim Lessons), not a standard

list.name: Trial lesson for a child (once per child; it places the child)
list.capacity: 1 trial spot in each group lesson
list.note: a parent or guardian books, signs the waiver and sets the pick-up list

list.name: Group lessons by age and level
list.price: on a monthly session (a trial first)
list.capacity: 4 swimmers per instructor in Preschool, 5 in Swim Kids, 6 parent-and-child pairs in Parent and Tot
list.note: Parent and Tot (6 months to 3 years, a parent in the water), Preschool 1 to 3 (ages 3 to 5), Swim Kids 1 to 6 (ages 6 to 12)

list.name: Monthly session, one group lesson a week
list.price: $112 a month (4 lessons; $96 for Parent and Tot)
list.kind: a plan, billed on the 1st of each month
list.before: the first month paid in full when enrolling; then the saved card on the 1st, with a text the day before
list.note: the plan's terms get their own yes; ended by the 20th for the next month (the school's setting)

list.name: Single group lesson (a swimmer already placed)
Private lesson at the school (any age)
list.note: one instructor and one swimmer; a child with a seizure history is booked only after Sam reads the note

list.name: Private lesson at the family's pool
list.note: the pool is fenced with a gate that latches; a parent or guardian stays at the pool's edge for the whole lesson

list.name: Group lesson at a host pool (a community center, an apartment pool)
list.note: with the host's written OK, under the host's pool rules

list.name: Lifeguard for a pool party (Lee Swim Lessons' second kind of work)
list.note: only lifeguards with a current lifeguard and CPR certificate; the lifeguard watches the water and teaches nothing

list.name: Make-up lesson
list.note: for a lesson the school or the pool cancelled, or one monthly-session lesson a month missed with notice

pf.services.trial: one trial per child, in a group lesson that fits the child's age and comfort in water; 1 trial spot per lesson; checked by the parent's mobile and the child's first name
pf.services.placement: by age first, then comfort in water: face in the water, floating, a few strokes alone; the trial places the child, and the instructor may move them after; a level above level 1 needs Sam's OK
pf.services.packs: the monthly session is sold on the secure page with its own yes and terms, never offered in a booking text
pf.services.capacity: swimmers per instructor, set by the school (a ratio from the state's form wins); 1 trial spot per lesson; each spot is one swimmer with their own check-in code; a private lesson is one instructor and one swimmer
pf.services.waitlist: a full lesson keeps a waitlist in order; a freed spot is offered by text inside text hours, to one family at a time, for 30 minutes
pf.services.minimum: none: a group lesson runs with one swimmer
pf.services.makeups: a lesson the school or the pool cancels: a free make-up or a full refund, never a fee; a monthly-session lesson missed with notice by 9am that day: one free make-up a month, in a lesson of the same level with room (the school's setting)
pf.services.skills: group lessons by level, Parent and Tot, private lessons, adult beginners, swimmers with extra needs (Sam's OK), lifeguarding
pf.services.online: never: every lesson is in the water
pf.services.nobodyHome: never: the swimmer must be there; for a child's lesson at home, a parent or guardian stays at the pool's edge the whole time

beforeTimes: who is swimming: the parent's own child, or the adult themselves
for a child: the age (it sets the lesson group)
comfort in water: puts their face in? floats? swims a few strokes alone? (it sets the level)
for a private lesson: at the school's pool or the family's own pool, and the goal
for a lesson at home: is the pool fenced, with a gate that latches?
afterTime: is the child potty-trained? (if not, a swim diaper is needed)
is anything about water scary for the swimmer, or anything the instructor should know?
for a lesson at home: the address, and the way to the pool gate
securePage: the parent or guardian's yes that they may book for the child, and the waiver signed for the child
the child's first name and age, health notes (like ear tubes, seizures or asthma) and an emergency contact
the pick-up list: the adults who may take the child home
a yes or no for photos or video of the child in the lesson
adults: their own waiver; Parent and Tot: the parent's own line too
pf.questions.whoMayBook: an adult for themselves; a parent or legal guardian for anyone under 18, who books, signs and gets every text; a teen gets a link to send to a parent

stop.words: a child who was in the water and is now coughing hard, struggling to breathe or very sleepy; someone hurt or unwell right now

goOn.words: a health note, like ear tubes or asthma
goOn.what: the booking goes on; the note goes on the secure page for the instructor; Rosie gives no health advice
Sam reads the note on the secure page before it's booked: often a private lesson, with the instructor within arm's reach

goOn.words: a child who is scared of water
goOn.what: the booking goes on; the note goes to the instructor, who goes slowly; a scared child is never forced

pf.safety.weather: lessons stop at the first thunder or lightning: everyone out of the water, and back in only after a set time with none (the school's setting, like 30 minutes); a lesson stopped this way gets a free make-up or a refund, never a fee
pf.safety.pool: the pool closes at once after a bathroom accident or vomit in the water, or when the water isn't safe, for the time the pool's rules set; lessons it hits get a free make-up or a refund
pf.safety.children: a parent or guardian stays on the pool deck for children under 6 (a switch for the age); at a home pool, a parent stays at the pool's edge for every child's lesson; a child is never alone with one adult behind a closed door; any worry about a child's safety goes to Sam at once, and Sam reports it where the state's rules require
pf.safety.always: the generic screen: danger to life, fire, gas, a medical emergency → call 911, and no booking

steps.name: Waiver and the child's details
steps.when: before the first lesson, signed on the secure page while booking
steps.who: a parent or guardian signs for anyone under 18; adults sign their own; in Parent and Tot, the parent also signs a line for themselves
steps.goodFor: 1 year, or until the school changes it
steps.result: signed: the booking goes on; not signed in 10 minutes: nothing is booked

steps.name: The pick-up list and the photo yes or no
steps.when: on the secure page while booking; the parent can change them any time
steps.result: only adults on the list take the child home; no answer to photos counts as no

steps.name: Placement
steps.when: the trial places the child; a level above level 1 is asked about before booking
steps.result: Sam OKs a level above level 1 first

steps.name: A seizure history
steps.when: when the secure page shows one
steps.result: Sam reads the note before it's booked; often a private lesson, the instructor within arm's reach

steps.name: The home pool check
steps.when: for a lesson at home, on the secure page while booking, and again when the instructor arrives
steps.result: the pool is fenced with a latching gate, the water is clear to the bottom, and a parent stays at the edge; if not, no lesson, and a make-up or a refund

pf.first_steps.prep: for the reminder: come 10 minutes early to check in; a swimsuit, a towel, and goggles if the child has them; a swim diaper (a disposable one under a reusable cover) for a child who isn't potty-trained; a parent stays on the deck; for a lesson at home, the gate unlocked and the pool cover off

pf.visit.checkIn: at the school: the parent gives the child's check-in code at the front desk, or the instructor ticks names on the lesson roster; at a home pool: the code at the gate; at a host pool: the host's contact gives the code
pf.visit.children: a child goes home only with an adult on the pick-up list; anyone else waits with staff while the parent is asked; a parent or guardian stays on the pool deck for children under 6 (a switch for the age)
pf.visit.water: the instructor watches the sky and the water the whole lesson; at the first thunder or lightning, everyone gets out
pf.visit.lateEntry: a late swimmer joins on arrival, and the lesson still ends on time
pf.visit.changes: an instructor change is texted to every parent booked; a level change after the trial goes in the instructor's note
pf.visit.done: the check-in code or the roster tick; at a home pool, the code at the gate or DONE from the instructor
pf.visit.note: after a trial, the instructor writes a short note on the secure page: what the child tried, how it went, and which level fits next; the parent gets a private link

pf.money.before: a trial, a single lesson and a private lesson (at the school or at home): paid in full when booking; a monthly session: the first month paid in full when enrolling, then each month on the saved card; a lesson at a host pool and a pool party lifeguard: paid in full when booking
pf.money.tuition: the monthly session is billed on the 1st to the saved card, with a text the day before; the plan's terms get their own yes; a parent can end it by the 20th for the next month (the school's setting; a longer notice or a cancel right from the state's form wins)
pf.money.caps: how far ahead lessons may be charged, and any bond or account kept apart for money paid ahead: from the state's form
pf.money.cancel: free to cancel a trial, a single or a private lesson until 24 hours before (the school's setting); a longer right to cancel from the state's form wins
pf.money.fees: a late cancel or a no-show for a trial, a single or a private lesson: the price paid may be kept only with Sam's OK, and no answer in 24 hours means a full refund; a monthly-session lesson missed is a make-up, never a refund or a fee
pf.money.makeups: when the school or the pool cancels (thunder or lightning, a pool closure, no instructor): a free make-up or a full refund, never a fee, and never kept as a credit without a yes; a lesson stopped by thunder or lightning before halfway gets the same; past halfway, it counts as taught (the school's setting)
pf.money.tax: no tax line, unless the owner sets one
pf.money.fee2: pays Rosfield's $2 for each confirmed booking
pf.money.leaveEarly: a lesson the swimmer leaves early counts as given: nothing comes back (the school's setting); a lesson the school stops for safety follows the make-up rule

pf.messages.never: a child's last name, age, health notes (like ear tubes or seizures), skills note, pick-up list or photos never go in a text; texts to the parent may use the child's first name only; texts to Sam or the staff carry no child details at all: they name the parent and the lesson, and link to the secure page
pf.messages.to: texts go only to the parent's phone, never to the child
pf.messages.minors: a teen under 18 gets a link to send to a parent; Rosie never texts the parent first
pf.messages.photos: photos or video of a child are shared only with the parent's yes, and never by text

pf.staff.skills: group lessons by level, Parent and Tot, private lessons, adult beginners, swimmers with extra needs, lifeguarding
pf.staff.certificates: each instructor in the water holds a current water safety instructor certificate and a CPR and first aid certificate; a lifeguard holds a current lifeguard certificate (switches from the state's form, on by default)
pf.staff.lifeguard: a lifeguard on the deck during lessons at the school's pool where the pool's rules require one (a switch)
pf.staff.checks: a background check on file for anyone who teaches or works with children, where the state's rules require it (a switch); a sub teaches only with their own certificates and check on file
pf.staff.supervision: a child is never alone with one adult behind a closed door; two adults on the deck for group lessons (the school's setting)
pf.staff.ratio: 4 swimmers per instructor in Preschool, 5 in Swim Kids, 6 parent-and-child pairs in Parent and Tot (the school's setting; a ratio from the state's form wins)
pf.staff.whoOKs: Sam places swimmers above level 1, reads seizure notes and OKs private lessons; Pat may OK them too
pf.staff.license: no person license for teaching swimming unless the state's form names one; the certificates above

items: the school's pool: a health permit, inspections and water tests where the state's or county's rules require them (a switch)
selling lessons ahead (a monthly session): any bond, account kept apart, written contract, cancel right, or limit on how far ahead money is taken comes from the state's form
a waiver is a risk notice and consent; where the state's rules limit what a parent may sign for a child, the state's form sets the words
instructor and lifeguard certificates, and background checks for people who work with children: from the state's form
a worry about a child's safety: Sam reports it where the state's rules require
a plan that renews: its terms, 30 days' notice before a price change, and how to end it; the state's form can set more
phone calls: the line always says first that the call is recorded
pf.rules.weather: thunder or lightning: everyone out of the water at once, and back in only after the school's set time with none (like 30 minutes)
pf.rules.photos: photos or video of a child: only with the parent's yes (on by default)

applies: the pool closes (thunder or lightning, a bathroom accident in the water, a water problem): every parent told at once, a free make-up or a full refund
thunder or lightning stops a lesson: before halfway, a free make-up or a refund; past halfway, it counts as taught
an instructor is out: a sub with current certificates, and parents told
a full lesson or no trial spot left: the waitlist, or another lesson that fits
a child who already swims: placed at the trial; a level above level 1 needs Sam's OK first
a scared child: stays on the step with the instructor, with no pressure, and is never forced
a child swallows water and coughs: lifted out and checked with the parent right there; 911 for trouble breathing; an incident note to Sam on the secure page
a seizure history: Sam reads the note first, often a private lesson
someone not on the pick-up list: the child stays with staff while the parent is asked
arriving late: joins on arrival, and the lesson still ends on time
a home pool that isn't safe on arrival (no latching gate, cloudy water, thunder): no lesson, and a make-up or a refund with no fee

Second company: Lee Swim School LLC (its own indoor heated pool, 140 Harbor Rd). Main company 77 Cove Rd; Alex's home 31 Birch Ln. Registrations SR418220 and SR41907; pool permit PP5512.

Placed by age and comfort in water into Preschool 1 (ages 3 to 5, 4 per instructor, 1 trial spot). Sat Oct 24 11:00 to 11:30am with Grace, $20 paid in full; waiver, health note (ear tubes), pick-up list and photo choice on the secure page; code 5160 at the front desk; Alex stays on the deck (a parent stays for a child under 6). Marcus, Thu Oct 22, starts 4:30pm, 30 minutes, $75 paid in full; day list 3:00pm, OMW 4:10pm, code at the pool gate 4:27pm, pool check (gate latches, water clear to the bottom, parent at the edge, no thunder) B8-45, DONE 5:00pm, receipt 5:00pm, rating 7:00pm.
Money paths, from the old flowchart (paid in full at booking: $20 trial, $28 single, $65 private) and the brief: one path per flow, list|full|none. The monthly session's later months are a plan on the saved card (A5-21, A7-32, A7-54, A7-55, A10-x03); B's weekly plan charges each lesson the day before (B5-21, B7-52). No holds, deposits, bills or card-at-DONE: a swim school isn't paid that way. The sign-up example (S1-12 to S1-17, S1-41 to S1-47) now sets every service paid in full.
Make-ups and fees: a lesson the school or pool calls off (thunder or lightning, a bathroom accident, a heating failure, no instructor) gets a free make-up or a full refund, never a fee, never a credit without a yes (A7-22, A8-40, A8-x02/x03, B8-x01/x02, B8-60). Thunder stops a lesson at once; before halfway a make-up or refund, past halfway it counts as taught. A late cancel or no-show for a trial, single or private lesson: the price may be kept only with Sam's OK, no answer in 24 hours means a refund (old flowchart). A missed monthly-session lesson is a make-up with notice, never a fee.
Water safety: a parent on the deck for a child under 6 (a switch for the age, A8-67), at a home pool a parent at the edge for every child's lesson (B4-26, B4-32, B8-67); thunder stops lessons (A8-x02, B8-x01; B7-35 forecast check for outdoor pools); pool closures (A7-22, A8-40); instructors' lifesaving and CPR certificates are switches from the state's form, on by default (S2-29, S11-50, S11-51); a scared child is never forced (A8-x01); a child who swallows water is lifted out and checked, 911 for trouble breathing (A8-38, B8-34). A seizure note goes to Sam before booking (A6-01, A6-02 to A6-21, B6-03).
Child safety and privacy: a parent or guardian books and signs (A4-24, A4-25, B4-32); the child's name, age, health notes, skills note, pick-up list and photos stay on the secure page; texts to the parent use the first name only; texts to Sam or staff name the parent and the lesson (A6-15, A8-01, A10-x04, B6-14, B8-01, B8-44). Pick-up only by a listed adult (A8-42). Background checks are a switch (S2-29).
Plug-in splits kept (splitsKept A): A4-66 (a spot in a group lesson, or an instructor's time for a private lesson), A7-59 and A7-61 (group lessons name no one; private lessons are by name; 'Nobody else, like extra needs'), A8-67 (children under 6 stay with a parent; older swimmers may be dropped off), S11-87, S11-90. A7-67 now turns off 'A minimum, by a cutoff' (a group lesson runs with one swimmer); A7-70 keeps only 'Shorter, in the time left' (a late swimmer joins on arrival, the lesson ends on time); A3-32 keeps only 'No walk-ins'.

State rules only as switches: the pool's health permit and inspections, certificates and background checks, selling lessons ahead (bond, account kept apart, contract, cancel right), the waiver's words for a child, reporting a worry about a child. The old flowchart's one-state call-recording, cancel-window and pool-permit rules are outdated as state rules: the line always says the call is recorded, and the cancel window is the school's setting with a longer state right winning.

Left as the master draws them: the section restarts (S2-01, S11-01, S12-01), A6-14 after the Sam's-OK what-if, A8-44 after the next-morning question, B4-77 after the other callers' what-ifs, B10-01 after the next-morning question, S11-41 after the AWAY branch.
Outdated in the old flowchart: the outside scheduling software (Acuity and others), one state's call-recording, cancel and pool-permit laws, and the founder's 'single and trial lessons only' rule (Jay's two flows include the monthly session, started on the note page, never by a sales text).
Keep: 'private lesson' is a real swim school service (the dance pilot had renamed 'color and cut' to it, so the checker counts it as a pilot word).

Leo teaches children too, with a background check (S2-04, S2-15, S2-21, S2-22, S2-29), as flow B always had him. The brother's second lesson, given that day, has no cancel period (B8-24, B10-05; branch 'Cancels by Mon Oct 26' off). Texts to Sam and staff carry no child's name or health detail (A7-12, B3-19, B7-16, B8-x01). Leaving early counts as given (pf.money.leaveEarly, A8-37).
